title: Reach Customers Across YouTube & Search - Google Ads

facts.fact: Google Ads sign-up offers require the advertiser to spend a target amount with Google Ads within the first 60 days to unlock the ad credit; the target amount is not filled in on the page.
facts.quote: Spend {$ion-cyo-target-amount} with Google Ads in the first 60 days to unlock the credit.

facts.fact: New Google Ads advertisers receive the ad credit only after meeting the minimum spend requirement for the selected sign-up offer.
facts.quote: New advertisers will receive an ad credit after meeting the minimum spend requirement for the selected offer.

facts.fact: To redeem a Google Ads sign-up offer, the advertiser must sign up and complete billing setup.
facts.quote: Sign up and complete billing setup to redeem your offer.

facts.fact: Google Ads allows multiple campaigns to be created within the same account without creating a new account.
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.
